data.value: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?

Torchlight Media is undergoing a restructuring. The managing director has the authority to inform staff about the decision. The works council must be consulted before the end of September. The current date is September 1, 2026.
